newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Bank, Hokkaido Takushoku shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Bank, Hokkaido Takushoku shares suspended.

text.p: Shares in Hokkaido Bank Ltd and Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd have been suspended from trade for the entire Tuesday session, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said.
The bourse said the shares were suspended due to uncertainties concerning the banks' intention to merge.
Hokkaido Bank Ltd president Tsuneo Fujita on Tuesday confirmed media reports that the banks planned to merge.
He said the two banks would hold a news conference at 10 a.m. (0100 GMT) to formally announce the deal. He gave no further details.

The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the deal would be a stock swap at an undetermined ratio, with the larger Hokkaido Takushoku to be the surviving entity. It said a new name for the merged bank had not yet been determined.
